entry.title: Vulnerabilities Resolved in Veeam Backup & Replication 13.1.2
entry.summary: Veeam Support Knowledge Base answer to: Vulnerabilities Resolved in Veeam Backup & Replication 13.1.2
entry.content:
Vulnerabilities Resolved in Veeam Backup & Replication 13.1.2

KB ID: 4948
Product: Veeam Backup & Replication | 13 | 13.1
Published: 2026-10-27
Last Modified: 2026-10-27
Veeam Software Security Commitment
Veeam® is committed to ensuring its products protect customers from potential risks. As part of that commitment, we operate a Vulnerability Disclosure Program (VDP) for all Veeam products and perform extensive internal code audits. When a vulnerability is identified, our team promptly develops a patch to address and mitigate the risk. In line with our dedication to transparency, we publicly disclose the vulnerability and provide detailed mitigation information. This approach ensures that all potentially affected customers can quickly implement the necessary measures to safeguard their systems. It’s important to note that once a vulnerability and its associated patch are disclosed, attackers will likely attempt to reverse-engineer the patch to exploit unpatched deployments of Veeam software. This reality underscores the critical importance of ensuring that all customers use the latest versions of our software and install all updates and patches without delay.

Issue Details

CVE-2026-108142

A vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authorization on the CDP Coordinator Service.

Severity: Critical
CVSS v4.0 Score: 9.1CVSS: AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:N/UI:N/VC:N/VI:H/VA:H/SC:N/SI:H/SA:H
Affected Deployment Type: Windows-based Veeam Backup & Replication | Veeam Software Appliance
Source: Reported through HackerOne.

Affected Product
  • Veeam Backup & Replication 13.1.1.18 and all earlier version 13.1 builds.
  • Veeam Backup & Replication 13.0.2.29 and all earlier version 13.0 builds.
    Note: Older versions (e.g., 12.x) are not affected.
Solution

This vulnerability was fixed starting in the following builds:

  • Veeam Backup & Replication 13.1.2 (build 13.1.2.57)
  • Veeam Backup & Replication 13.0.3 (build 13.0.3.63)

CVE-2026-108140

A vulnerability allowing an authenticated user with the Restore Operator role, who also controls the contents of a backed-up NAS share, to write attacker-controlled files to an arbitrary path on the backup server through relative path traversal.

Severity: Medium
CVSS v4.0 Score: 5.9CVSS: AV:N/AC:H/AT:P/PR:H/UI:N/VC:N/VI:H/VA:L/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N
Affected Deployment Type: Windows-based Veeam Backup & Replication | Veeam Software Appliance
Source: Reported through HackerOne.

Affected Product
  • Veeam Backup & Replication 13.1.1.18 and all earlier version 13.1 builds.
  • Veeam Backup & Replication 13.0.2.29 and all earlier version 13.0 builds.
    Note: Older versions (e.g., 12.x) are not affected.
Solution

This vulnerability was fixed starting in the following builds:

  • Veeam Backup & Replication 13.1.2 (build 13.1.2.57)
  • Veeam Backup & Replication 13.0.3 (build 13.0.3.63)

CVE-2026-108141

A vulnerability allowing an authenticated user with the Restore Operator role, who also controls the contents of a backed-up NAS share, to write attacker-controlled files to an arbitrary path on the backup server through relative path traversal.

Severity: Medium
CVSS v4.0 Score: 5.9CVSS: AV:N/AC:H/AT:P/PR:H/UI:N/VC:N/VI:H/VA:L/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N
Affected Deployment Type: Windows-based Veeam Backup & Replication | Veeam Software Appliance
Source: Reported through HackerOne.

Affected Product
  • Veeam Backup & Replication 13.1.1.18 and all earlier version 13.1 builds.
  • Veeam Backup & Replication 13.0.2.29 and all earlier version 13.0 builds.
    Note: Older versions (e.g., 12.x) are not affected.
Solution

This vulnerability was fixed starting in the following builds:

  • Veeam Backup & Replication 13.1.2 (build 13.1.2.57)
  • Veeam Backup & Replication 13.0.3 (build 13.0.3.63)

CVE-2026-105477

A vulnerability in Veeam Agent for Linux allows for local privilege escalation. Only installations that are managed by a Veeam Backup & Replication instance are affected.

Severity: High
CVSS v4.0 Score: 7.3CVSS: AV:L/AC:L/AT:P/PR:L/UI:N/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N
Source: Reported through HackerOne.

Affected Product
  • Veeam Agent for Linux 13.1.1.4 and all earlier version 13.1 builds.
    Note: Older versions (e.g., 13.0.x and 6.x) are not affected.
Solution

This vulnerability was fixed starting in the following build:

  • Veeam Agent for Linux 13.1.2 (build 13.1.2.11)

entry.title: Vulnerabilities Resolved in Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 8.6
entry.summary: Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 8.6 resolves four vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-106078, CVE-2026-106077, CVE-2026-106076, and CVE-2025-64394) in the Windows-based server. This article lists the severity, CVSS score, affected builds, and fixed builds for each vulnerability.
entry.content:
Vulnerabilities Resolved in Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 8.6

KB ID: 4957
Product: Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 | 8.6
Published: 2026-10-27
Last Modified: 2026-10-26
Veeam Software Security Commitment
Veeam® is committed to ensuring its products protect customers from potential risks. As part of that commitment, we operate a Vulnerability Disclosure Program (VDP) for all Veeam products and perform extensive internal code audits. In line with our dedication to transparency, we publicly disclose the vulnerability and provide detailed mitigation information. This approach ensures that all potentially affected customers can quickly implement the necessary measures to safeguard their systems. It’s important to note that once a vulnerability and its associated patch are disclosed, attackers will likely attempt to reverse-engineer the patch to exploit unpatched deployments of Veeam software. This reality underscores the critical importance of ensuring that all customers use the latest versions of our software and install all updates and patches without delay.

Issue Details

CVE-2026-106076

A vulnerability allowing an authenticated organization-transfer peer to inject SQL into the configuration database of the source Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 server, leading to cross-tenant read and write of configuration data and remote code execution as the PostgreSQL service account.

Severity: Critical
CVSS v4.0 Score: 9.0CVSS: AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:L/UI:N/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:H/SI:H/SA:H
Source: Reported through HackerOne.

Affected Product
  • Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 8.5.0.1014 and all earlier version 8 builds.
    Note: Unsupported product versions were not tested, but are likely affected and should be considered vulnerable.
Solution

This vulnerability was fixed starting in the following build:

  • Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 8.6 (build 8.6.0.1102)

CVE-2026-106077

A vulnerability allowing a user with the Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 Administrator role to read arbitrary files on the backup server with LocalSystem privileges.

Severity: High
CVSS v4.0 Score: 8.3CVSS: AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:H/UI:N/VC:H/VI:N/VA:N/SC:H/SI:H/SA:N
Source: Reported through HackerOne.

Affected Product
  • Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 8.5.0.1014 and all earlier version 8 builds.
    Note: Unsupported product versions were not tested, but are likely affected and should be considered vulnerable.
Solution

This vulnerability was fixed starting in the following build:

  • Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 8.6 (build 8.6.0.1102)

CVE-2026-106078

A vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated attacker to bypass REST API authentication with a forged federation token and receive responses from REST API endpoints that do not call the Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 backup service.

Severity: Medium
CVSS v4.0 Score: 6.9CVSS: AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:L/VI:N/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N
Source: Reported through HackerOne.

Affected Product
  • Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 8.6.0.1102 and all earlier version 8 builds.
    Note: Unsupported product versions were not tested, but are likely affected and should be considered vulnerable.
Solution

This vulnerability was fixed starting in the following build:

  • Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 8.6 Patch 1 (build 8.6.0.5011)

CVE-2025-64394

A vulnerability allowing a low-privileged local user to write arbitrary files with SYSTEM privileges during the installation of Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365, which can lead to privilege escalation or denial of service.

Severity: Medium
CVSS v4.0 Score: 4.3CVSS: AV:L/AC:L/AT:P/PR:L/UI:A/VC:N/VI:L/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N
Source: Reported through HackerOne.

Affected Product
  • Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 8.6.0.1102 and all earlier version 8 builds.
    Note: Unsupported product versions were not tested, but are likely affected and should be considered vulnerable.
Solution

This vulnerability was fixed starting in the following build:

  • Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 8.6 Patch 1 (build 8.6.0.5011)

entry.summary: Vulnerabilities Resolved in Veeam Backup & Replication 12.3.2 P4
entry.content:
Vulnerabilities Resolved in Veeam Backup & Replication 12.3.2 P4

KB ID: 4934
Product: Veeam Backup & Replication | 12 | 12.1 | 12.2 | 12.3 | 12.3.1 | 12.3.2
Published: 2026-10-06
Last Modified: 2026-10-06
Article Applicability

All vulnerabilities listed in this article:

  • Affect only Veeam Backup & Replication 12.3.2 P3 (build 12.3.2.4854) and older builds.
  • Are resolved in Veeam Backup & Replication 12.3.2 P4 (build 12.3.2.4934).
  • Do not affect any Veeam Backup & Replication version 13 builds.

Customers are reminded that Veeam Backup & Replication version 12 will reach End of Support on 2027-02-28.

Veeam Software Security Commitment
Veeam® is committed to ensuring its products protect customers from potential risks. As part of that commitment, we operate a Vulnerability Disclosure Program (VDP) for all Veeam products and perform extensive internal code audits. When a vulnerability is identified, our team promptly develops a patch to address and mitigate the risk. In line with our dedication to transparency, we publicly disclose the vulnerability and provide detailed mitigation information. This approach ensures that all potentially affected customers can quickly implement the necessary measures to safeguard their systems. It’s important to note that once a vulnerability and its associated patch are disclosed, attackers will likely attempt to reverse-engineer the patch to exploit unpatched deployments of Veeam software. This reality underscores the critical importance of ensuring that all customers use the latest versions of our software and install all updates and patches without delay.

Issue Details

CVE-2025-64393

A vulnerability allowing a low-privileged user with the Backup Viewer role to perform remote code execution (RCE) on the Veeam Backup Server through insecure deserialization of untrusted data received via the Mount Service.

Severity: Critical
CVSS v4.0 Score: 9.4CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:L/UI:N/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:H/SI:H/SA:H
Source: Reported through HackerOne.

Affected Product
  • Veeam Backup & Replication 12.3.2.4854 and all earlier version 12 builds.
    Note: Version 13 is not affected.
Solution

This vulnerability was fixed starting in the following build:

  • Veeam Backup & Replication 12.3.2 P4 (build 12.3.2.4934)

CVE-2026-93026

A vulnerability allowing an authenticated user with the Backup Viewer role to modify or delete the Enterprise Manager master key and read or overwrite stored antivirus update credentials on the Veeam Backup Server.

Severity: Medium
CVSS v4.0 Score: 6.1CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:L/UI:N/VC:L/VI:H/VA:L/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N
Source: Reported through HackerOne.

Affected Product
  • Veeam Backup & Replication 12.3.2.4854 and all earlier version 12 builds.
    Note: Version 13 is not affected.
Solution

This vulnerability was fixed starting in the following build:

  • Veeam Backup & Replication 12.3.2 P4 (build 12.3.2.4934)

CVE-2025-64392

A reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in Veeam Backup Enterprise Manager allows an attacker to execute script in the browser of an authenticated portal user who opens a crafted link.

Severity: Medium
CVSS v4.0 Score: 4.8CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:L/UI:A/VC:N/VI:N/VA:N/SC:L/SI:L/SA:N
Source: Reported through HackerOne.

Affected Product
  • Veeam Backup Enterprise Manager (Veeam Backup & Replication) 12.3.2.4854 and all earlier version 12 builds.
    Note: Version 13 is not affected.
Solution

This vulnerability was fixed starting in the following build:

  • Veeam Backup & Replication 12.3.2 P4 (build 12.3.2.4934)

entry.summary: Vulnerabilities Resolved in Veeam Backup & Replication 13.1
entry.content:
Vulnerabilities Resolved in Veeam Backup & Replication 13.1

KB ID: 4902
Product: Veeam Backup & Replication | 12 | 13
Published: 2026-08-25
Last Modified: 2026-10-05
Veeam Software Security Commitment
Veeam® is committed to ensuring its products protect customers from potential risks. As part of that commitment, we operate a Vulnerability Disclosure Program (VDP) for all Veeam products and perform extensive internal code audits. When a vulnerability is identified, our team promptly develops a patch to address and mitigate the risk. In line with our dedication to transparency, we publicly disclose the vulnerability and provide detailed mitigation information. This approach ensures that all potentially affected customers can quickly implement the necessary measures to safeguard their systems. It’s important to note that once a vulnerability and its associated patch are disclosed, attackers will likely attempt to reverse-engineer the patch to exploit unpatched deployments of Veeam software. This reality underscores the critical importance of ensuring that all customers use the latest versions of our software and install all updates and patches without delay.

Issue Details

CVE-2026-58070

A vulnerability that causes guest OS credentials used for Application Aware processing to be recorded in cleartext in logs on the guest machine.

Severity: Medium
CVSS v4.0 Score: 6.8CVSS: AV:L/AC:L/AT:N/PR:L/UI:N/VC:H/VI:N/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N
Affected Deployment Type: Windows-based Veeam Backup & Replication | Veeam Software Appliance
Source: Reported through HackerOne.

Affected Product
  • Veeam Backup & Replication 13.0.2.29 and all earlier version 13 builds.
    Note: Older versions (e.g., 12.x) are not affected.
Solution

This vulnerability was fixed starting in the following builds:

  • Veeam Backup & Replication 13.1 (build 13.1.0.411)
  • Veeam Backup & Replication 13.0.3 (build 13.0.3.63)
CVE-2026-58070 Impact Mitigation
The fix that addresses CVE-2026-58070 prevents future incidences of passwords being written to the log files. The log files that have already been written will not be removed. Customers are therefore advised to change the password(s) associated with the credentials used for Application-Aware Processing.

CVE-2026-58069

A vulnerability allowing an authenticated Veeam Cloud Connect tenant to read arbitrary files on the service provider host.

Severity: High
CVSS v4.0 Score: 8.3CVSS: AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:L/UI:N/VC:H/VI:N/VA:N/SC:H/SI:N/SA:N
Affected Deployment Type: Windows-based Veeam Backup & Replication
Source: Reported through HackerOne.

Affected Product
  • Veeam Backup & Replication 13.0.2.29 and all earlier version 13 builds.
  • Veeam Backup & Replication 12.3.2.4854 and all earlier versions of 12 builds.
    Note: Unsupported product versions were not tested, but are likely affected and should be considered vulnerable.
Solution

This vulnerability was fixed starting in the following builds:

  • Veeam Backup & Replication 13.1 (build 13.1.0.411)
  • Veeam Backup & Replication 13.0.3 (build 13.0.3.63)
  • Veeam Backup & Replication 12.3.2 P4 (build 12.3.2.4934)

CVE-2026-58068

A vulnerability that allows an attacker to trigger a denial-of-service condition affecting processes on the affected system.

Severity: Medium
CVSS v4.0 Score: 6.8CVSS: AV:L/AC:L/AT:N/PR:L/UI:N/VC:N/VI:N/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N
Source: Reported through HackerOne.

Affected Product
  • Veeam Agent for Microsoft Windows 13.0.4.1341 and all earlier version 13 and 6 builds.
    Note: Unsupported product versions were not tested, but are likely affected and should be considered vulnerable.
Solution

This vulnerability was fixed starting in the following build:

  • Veeam Agent for Microsoft Windows 13.1 (build 13.1.0.544)

CVE-2025-64391

A vulnerability allowing a local user to write arbitrary files as SYSTEM by manipulating mount points and symbolic links during installation.

Severity: Medium
CVSS v4.0 Score: 4.1CVSS: AV:L/AC:L/AT:P/PR:L/UI:P/VC:N/VI:H/VA:N/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N
Source: Reported through HackerOne.

Affected Product
  • Veeam Agent for Microsoft Windows 13.0.4.1341 and all earlier version 13 and 6 builds.
    Note: Unsupported product versions were not tested, but are likely affected and should be considered vulnerable.
Solution

This vulnerability was fixed starting in the following builds:

  • Veeam Agent for Microsoft Windows 13.1 (build 13.1.0.544)

Last Modified: 2026-08-05

A vulnerability in Veeam Service Provider Console allowing an unauthenticated attacker to impersonate a managed agent and obtain that agent's credentials.

CVSS v4.0 Score: 9.5CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:H/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:H/SI:H/SA:H

entry.summary: Veeam Software Appliance/Veeam Infrastructure Appliance — Updater Component Vulnerability
entry.content:
Veeam Software Appliance/Veeam Infrastructure Appliance — Updater Component Vulnerability

KB ID: 4879
Product: Veeam Backup & Replication | 13
Published: 2026-07-14
Last Modified: 2026-07-14
Veeam Software Security Commitment
Veeam® is committed to ensuring its products protect customers from potential risks. As part of that commitment, we operate a Vulnerability Disclosure Program (VDP) for all Veeam products and perform extensive internal code audits. When a vulnerability is identified, our team promptly develops a patch to address and mitigate the risk. In line with our dedication to transparency, we publicly disclose the vulnerability and provide detailed mitigation information. This approach ensures that all potentially affected customers can quickly implement the necessary measures to safeguard their systems. It’s important to note that once a vulnerability and its associated patch are disclosed, attackers will likely attempt to reverse-engineer the patch to exploit unpatched deployments of Veeam software. This reality underscores the critical importance of ensuring that all customers use the latest versions of our software and install all updates and patches without delay.

Vulnerability Details

A vulnerability in the Veeam Updater component allows a local user to elevate their privileges and gain root-level access to the underlying operating system.

Severity: High
CVSS Score: 8.4CVSS:4.0/AV:L/AC:L/AT:N/PR:H/UI:N/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N
Source: Reported through HackerOne by skydesperados.

Impacted Components:

  • Veeam Software Appliance (Linux-based Veeam Backup & Replication Server)
  • Veeam Infrastructure Appliance
This vulnerability does not affect Windows-based Veeam Backup & Replication backup servers, but may affect remote components that utilize the Veeam Infrastructure Appliance.

Solution

This vulnerability is resolved starting in the Veeam Updater component version 12.3.0.65.

  • Automatic Update Deployment — For most users, no action is needed, as the Veeam Updater component installs the fix automatically during its automatic update check.
  • Manual Update Deployment — If the Veeam Software Appliance or any Veeam Infrastructure Appliance is unable to reach either repository.veeam.com or a local mirror repository, the fix must be applied manually with assistance from Veeam Support, or temporary internet access to the update server must be configured.

For more information about Veeam Appliance Update configuration, review the product user guide:
Veeam Backup & Replication User Guide: Updating Veeam Appliances

Deployment Verification

To verify that the Veeam Updater component has been updated, review the component versions on the Veeam Software Appliance or Veeam Infrastructure Appliance using its Host Management Console:

  1. Open the appliance's Host Management Console Web UI.
  2. In the left-side navigation list, select the Logs and Services section under the Support heading.
  3. Within the Logs and Services view, select the Components tab.
  4. Review the list of installed components and their respective versions (optionally use the filter).
  5. Verify that the Veeam Updater component version listed is 12.3.0.65 or higher.
